# IGI Global Scientific Publishing

> International academic publisher specializing in peer-reviewed books, journals, and research databases across 200+ disciplines including AI, cybersecurity, engineering, and business.

IGI Global provides comprehensive publishing solutions through its InfoSci Platform, offering access to curated collections, open-access journals, and on-demand research papers. The platform serves researchers, librarians, institutions, and businesses globally with tools for manuscript submission, collection management, and clinical/business solutions.

## Key Topics

- Academic Publishing
- Peer-Reviewed Research
- Open Access Journals
- Research Databases
- InfoSci Platform
- E-Book Collections
- Scholarly Publishing
- Manuscript Submission
- Artificial Intelligence
- Science, Technology & Medicine (STM)
- OnDemand Plus
- EBSCO Integration
- Web of Science
- Scopus Indexed
- Business & Management Research

## Core Publishing Collections

- [Books](https://www.igi-global.com/books): Reference books in AI, cybersecurity, engineering, and related fields
- [Journals](https://www.igi-global.com/journals): Double-anonymous peer-reviewed journals across 200+ disciplines
- [e-Book Collection](https://www.igi-global.com/e-resources/e-collections/e-book-collection): e-Book collection with EBSCO, CLOCKSS, LOCKSS, and RefWorks integration
- [OnDemand Database](https://www.igi-global.com/e-resources/ondemand): OnDemand database of peer-reviewed research papers and chapters
- [InfoSci Platform Database Search](https://www.igi-global.com/infosci-demo): InfoSci Platform database search for books and journals

## Publishing & Submission

- [Publish with IGI Global](https://www.igi-global.com/publish): Publishing guidelines for research books and open-access journals
- [Researchers](https://www.igi-global.com/researchers): Researcher resources for open access and manuscript submission

## User Portals & Access

- [IGI Global Portal](https://www.igi-global.com/portal): Publisher portal for eEditorial, InfoScipedia, and InfoSci Platform
- [Librarians](https://www.igi-global.com/librarians): Librarian resources for e-book licensing and collection management
- [Clinical Solutions](https://www.igi-global.com/e-resources/clinical): Clinical solutions with OnDemand Plus for medical research
- [Business Solutions](https://www.igi-global.com/e-resources/business-medical-solutions): Business solutions with e-book collections and OnDemand Plus
